obligations.note: The diff changes Retention.isPurgeDue so that the legal-hold check no longer applies to WITHDRAWN cases (`isLegalHold() && status() != WITHDRAWN`). Withdrawn cases on legal hold now become purge-due, which breaks the requirement that NPI is never purged while a legal hold applies. The passing sample control test sampledPurgeRespectsHold evidently does not cover the withdrawn-plus-hold case.
The register has no exception for RET-1 on component mortgage.retention. The deviation from RET-1 is therefore not covered by any approved, unexpired, in-scope exception.
Ticket CHG-26821 is standard and was approved by change manager grace.kim on 2026-10-06, before review. Its component mortgage.retention covers the only touched path, Retention.java.
The code_review approval is from declan.farrell@fernbrook.example, a change_approver for baseline-mortgage. He is a different person from the author, Priya Raman.
The approval names the head commit 289039e5, which is the only commit in the change.

run.json reports success on the head commit from ci-runner-01 at 2026-10-09. The attached JUnit reports, however, are stamped 2026-10-23 (after the 2026-10-12 review time) on host dev-laptop-7.local, so they cannot be tied to this CI run. The RET-1 control test is also only a sample.
The only touched component, mortgage.retention, is not marked security_sensitive, so no security_review is required.
No protected paths (controls/, control tests, ci/) are changed, so no control_owner approval is required.
No acceptance-ledger entry covers Retention.java, so no prior evidence lapses because of this change.

summary: The change removes the legal-hold guard for withdrawn mortgage cases, so their NPI can be purged while under legal hold. This directly violates RET-1. No approved exception covers the deviation, and the change description ('simplify hold handling') obscures the control impact. The CI evidence is also inconsistent: the JUnit reports postdate the review time and come from a local workstation rather than the recorded CI runner. The change is rejected.
